products.name: Oreo Original Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
products.summary: Oreo has a complete source-backed package journey across the vintage slots, with two photo-derived vintage text extracts now visible. The recipe journey is still locked because no comparable ingredient statement has been manually verified.
products.story_thesis: The visible story is now the proof chase plus the first extraction layer: early and 1993 photos reveal candidate label text, but original-to-current ingredient comparison cannot publish until those extracts become reviewed text.
products.claim_boundary: 1912 original ingredient label not verified. Do not imply a verified original recipe or a full original-to-current formulation diff.
products.next_unlock: Review the supplied Flickr screenshots against the source pages, capture higher-resolution label panels where possible, and attach reviewer attribution before comparing ingredients.

photo_quality_summary.headline: User-supplied photo review unlocked two vintage text extracts.
photo_quality_summary.can_prove: Era/package presence, source owner, visible candidate terms on the 1950s-1960s wrapper, and a readable 1993 ingredient/nutrition panel candidate.
photo_quality_summary.cannot_prove: A verified original recipe, a verified formulation diff, package weight normalization, or ingredient claims beyond the legible extract text.
photo_quality_summary.highest_value_next: Confirm the 1993 panel against the Flickr source image, find higher-resolution early wrapper/back-panel photos, then run manual review before comparing oil or sweetener changes.
